rule.name: HandleReleasedOnlyOnSuccess
rule.message: The value this stage receives is closed or released only inside a later success stage (thenApply, thenCompose, thenAccept). When a later stage fails, the future completes exceptionally and the release never runs, so the handle leaks with its buffers and timers. Release it where every outcome passes: read(handle).whenComplete((result, error) -> close(handle)), or handle(...) with the release first. An exception fits a handle that a later stage stores or returns, so the owner releases it.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $success := ('thenCompose', 'thenApply', 'thenAccept', 'thenRun', 'thenComposeAsync', 'thenApplyAsync', 'thenAcceptAsync', 'thenRunAsync', 'thenCombine', 'thenAcceptBoth'), $always := ('whenComplete', 'whenCompleteAsync', 'handle', 'handleAsync', 'exceptionally', 'exceptionallyCompose', 'exceptionallyAsync'), $release := '^(close|asyncClose|closeAsync|release|dispose|returnConnection|releaseConnection)', $stage := function($lambda, $names) { exists($lambda[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = $names]]) } return //LambdaExpression[$stage(., $success)][LambdaParameterList[@Size = 1]/LambdaParameter/VariableId] [let $outer := ., $p := LambdaParameterList/LambdaParameter/VariableId/@Name, $releases := .//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $release)] [*[1][self::VariableAccess][@Name = $p] or ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $p]] return exists($releases) and empty(.//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('complete', 'put', 'putIfAbsent', 'set', 'add', 'offer')] [ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $p]]) and empty(.//AssignmentExpression[*[2][self::VariableAccess][@Name = $p]]) and empty(.//ReturnStatement/VariableAccess[@Name = $p]) and (every $r in $releases satisfies (let $lambdas := $r/ancestor::LambdaExpression[$outer intersect ancestor::*] return exists($lambdas) and $stage($lambdas[1], $success) and (every $l in $lambdas satisfies not($stage($l, $always))) and empty($r/ancestor::FinallyClause | $r/ancestor::CatchClause)))]
